Render a table or listing to RTF

Source: R/rtf.R
tlf_rtf_table.Rd

Applies the configured page geometry, running header, title block, body fonts, footnotes and source line, and writes an RTF file. Footnotes carried by a tlf_table result (for example a hazard ratio) are appended after the title-block footnotes. An empty table renders as a single "No data to report." row rather than failing.

Usage

tlf_rtf_table(
  x,
  file,
  titles = NULL,
  config = NULL,
  colheader = NULL,
  col_rel_width = NULL,
  text_justification = NULL
)

tlf_rtf_listing(
  x,
  file,
  titles = NULL,
  config = NULL,
  colheader = NULL,
  col_rel_width = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A tlf_table result from a builder, a pre-formatted data frame whose cells are printed as-is, a gtsummary table, or a cards card object; anything as_tlf_table() can convert.

file

Output .rtf path.

titles

A tlf_titles() object (for example from tlf_resolve_titles()), a character vector of title lines, or NULL.

config

A tlf_config(); NULL resolves through tlf_get_config().

colheader

Column header string in r2rtf " | " format. The default uses the column names.

col_rel_width

Relative column widths. The default is the builder's widths, or equal widths.

text_justification

Body justification per column ("l", "c", "r"), recycled.

Value

file, invisibly.

Details

Tables and listings need no graphics device and render in-process.

Examples

res <- tbl_demographics(ex_adsl)
f <- tempfile(fileext = ".rtf")
tlf_rtf_table(res, f, titles = tlf_titles("Demographics", number = "14.1.1"))
unlink(f)
